name: CyberiaTrader
summary: CyberiaTrader is a momentum-based Expert Advisor that identifies rapid price movements and enters trades in the direction of momentum spikes. It uses a proprietary calculation method to detect abnormal price action velocity and executes market orders with fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels. The EA is designed for high-frequency trading on M1-M15 timeframes with aggressive entry timing.
summary_zh: CyberiaTrader是一个基于动量的智能交易系统，通过检测价格异常波动速度来捕捉快速行情。它使用专有的计算方法识别动量脉冲方向，并在检测到信号时立即执行市价单，配合固定止盈止损。该EA专为M1-M15时间框架的高频交易设计，入场时机非常激进。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念：CyberiaTrader的核心思想是检测价格运动的加速度和动量异常，当价格在短时间内出现异常快速的移动时，认为趋势将延续并顺势入场。入场条件：通过计算当前价格与历史价格之间的速度差异，当速度超过动态阈值时产生交易信号，做多信号出现在价格向上加速时，做空信号出现在价格向下加速时。出场条件：使用固定点数的止盈和止损，也可以通过反向动量信号平仓。仓位管理：采用固定手数交易，部分版本支持基于账户余额的比例仓位调整。资金管理：虽然设有止损，但动量交易在市场转折时容易出现滑点，且固定止损在波动剧烈时可能不够灵活，缺乏追踪止损机制也是一大缺陷。
strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of CyberiaTrader is detecting price acceleration and momentum anomalies, entering trades when price moves abnormally fast in a direction, assuming the momentum will continue. Entry conditions are generated when price velocity exceeds a dynamic threshold calculated from historical price data; buy signals occur on upward acceleration and sell signals on downward acceleration. Exit conditions use fixed pip take-profit and stop-loss levels, with additional option to close on reverse momentum signals. Position sizing uses fixed lots by default, with some versions supporting balance-proportional lot calculation. Money management relies on fixed stop-losses which may not adapt well to changing volatility, and the absence of a trailing stop means profits can evaporate during momentum reversals; slippage during high-volatility entries is also a significant concern.
pros: 动量检测算法独特，能捕捉突发行情的起始阶段
入场速度快，对短线趋势爆发反应灵敏
参数相对简洁，用户调整难度低
pros_en: Unique momentum detection algorithm that captures the onset of sudden market moves
Fast entry execution with high sensitivity to short-term momentum explosions
Relatively simple parameter set makes configuration straightforward for users
cons: 固定止损止盈不适应市场波动性变化，在不同行情下表现差异大
动量交易在震荡市中会产生大量虚假信号和连续亏损
缺乏有效的追踪止损机制，盈利单容易被回撤吞没
cons_en: Lack of effective trailing stop mechanism means winning trades often give back profits on retracements
improvements: 增加ATR自适应止损止盈，根据市场波动性动态调整
加入趋势过滤器(如EMA或ADX)，避免在震荡行情中频繁交易
improvements_en: Add ATR-based adaptive TP/SL that dynamically adjusts based on market volatility
Implement a trend filter (e.g., EMA or ADX) to avoid excessive trading in ranging markets

risk_points: M1/M15高频动量交易在点差扩大时滑点严重
固定止损在剧烈波动中可能被跳空穿过
缺乏最大连亏限制和日内亏损上限保护
risk_points_en: High-frequency momentum trading on M1/M15 suffers severe slippage when spreads widen
Fixed stop-loss can be gap-through during extreme volatility events
No maximum consecutive loss limit or daily drawdown cap for account protection

The EA is designed for high-frequency trading on M1-M15 timeframes with aggressive entry timing.
